term: same necessary first bearer without composition and remote from all
definition: One and the same actual concrete root at w exists at every world accessible from w, has no distinct simply-prior predecessor, is in potency in no supplied respect, is not Composite, and is a ComponentOf nothing. Rootness concerns the selected relation at w. The scope of Composite and ComponentOf must be justified independently; no positive InAct perfection, essence/esse identity, uniqueness, maximum, universal causal coverage or God identification is asserted.
note: A source-free conjunction packaging existing ActualRoot, NecessaryAt, IsFirstBeing, PureAct, Composite and RemoteFromAll predicates for conditional composition. It introduces no new relation or claim about Aquinas. Independent sourcing would need to defend the same selected candidate domain and structural-premise applicability; the component sense and complete coverage of alleged compositions cannot follow from the wrapper name.
